title: Debugging Megascale Hangs
description: Workflow for diagnosing Megascale hangs. CRITICAL: You MUST run [[locate-megascale-hang-timestamp]] and [[query-coordinator-logs-around-timestamp]] first to check coordinator hang digests and tail surrounding failure context. When the digest is Unknown or requires worker-level corroboration, run [[diagnose-sflag-hang]] (for TC/SC sflag outlier grouping, tag:pc halts, DCN action stalls, and silent/missing pod detection) alongside [[analyze-libtpu-timing]] (for per-launch_id program enqueue/completion skew and fingerprint mismatch detection). Ignore worker cancellation warnings during coordinator check.
